image_description: A close-up, low-resolution view of a grey whale's back and dorsal area surfacing in turquoise water. The skin is dark grey/black with characteristic white mottling (barnacles/lice). No head, flippers, or tail are visible; only the mid-section of the body is shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
